title: Mouse Pancreas Dissection and Fixation for Cryosectioning
author: Islet and Pancreas Analysis Core
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.b2fdqbi6

steps.title: Prepare Ketamine/Xylazine Working Solution
steps.instruction: Prepare the anesthesia solution using 5 mL syringes with 18G needles, labeling all bottles with additive, mix date, and expiration date of the earliest-expiring ingredient.

substeps.instruction: Inject 2 mL of xylazine into a 10 mL bottle of ketamine.
Inject 2 mL of the resulting ketamine/xylazine mixture into a 10 mL bottle of saline.

steps.title: Anesthetize Mice
steps.instruction: Administer anesthesia and verify the state of the mice.

substeps.instruction: Inject mice intraperitoneally with ketamine/xylazine solution (1 μl/mg body weight) using a 1 mL syringe with a 27G needle.
Place mice into a plastic bin with air holes.
After 5-10 minutes, check for full anesthesia by gently pinching feet and tail.
If a jerking or squeaking response occurs, inject approximately 100 μL more of ketamine/xylazine solution and wait a few more minutes.

steps.title: Prepare PBS and Fixation Reagents
steps.instruction: Prepare the necessary buffers and solutions for fixation and cryoprotection.

substeps.instruction: Prepare 0.1 M PBS (1 L): Dissolve 12.07 g Na2HPO4 (dibasic), 8.0 g NaCl, and 2.0 g KCl in 1 L Milli-Q water. (Store at 4 °C and use within 1 month if sterile filtered).
Prepare 4% Paraformaldehyde (PFA): Dilute one ampule (10 mL) of 16% PFA in 30 mL 0.1 M PBS. Make fresh on the day of fixation.
Prepare 30% Sucrose: Dissolve 15 g sucrose in 35 mL 10 mM PBS; use a shaker to ensure full dissolution.

steps.title: Prepare Sample Tubes
steps.instruction: Prepare labeled 15 mL conical tubes for each pancreas.

substeps.instruction: Pipet 13 mL aliquots of the required reagent into each tube.
Record the weight of each empty tube to the nearest 0.01 g using an analytical balance.

steps.title: Dissect Mouse Pancreas
steps.instruction: Surgically remove the pancreas from the mouse.

substeps.instruction: Place mouse face up on the surgical stage, tape limbs down, and wipe with 70% ethanol.
Open the body cavity using forceps and scissors; move stomach and intestines aside to locate the pancreas.
Use two pairs of forceps to separate the pancreas from the duodenum and stomach, starting from the head.
Remove the pancreas with the spleen still attached.

steps.title: Clean and Trim Pancreas
steps.instruction: Clean the tissue in ice-cold PBS.

substeps.instruction: Place the pancreas in a 100 mm tissue culture dish containing 10 mL ice-cold 10 mM PBS.
Dissect away the spleen and remove all attached fat tissue.
If excess bleeding occurs, rinse the pancreas in an additional 10 mL ice-cold 10 mM PBS before removing fat.

steps.title: Fix Pancreas Tissue
steps.instruction: Fix the tissue and record weights.

substeps.instruction: Place the pancreas into the preweighed 15 mL tube containing 4% PFA.
Record the weight of the tube containing the pancreas to the nearest 0.01 g using an analytical balance.
Fix the pancreas for 02:00:00 on ice with gentle agitation using a shaker at low speed.

steps.title: Wash and Cryoprotect Pancreas
steps.instruction: Wash the fixed tissue and treat with sucrose.

substeps.instruction: Decant fixative and wash the pancreas 4 times in approximately 13 mL 0.1 M PBS for 00:30:00, keeping tubes on ice with gentle agitation on a shaker at low speed.
Decant PBS and add approximately 13 mL 30% sucrose.
Store overnight at 4 °C to cryoprotect the pancreas.

steps.title: Embed Pancreas in OCT
steps.instruction: Prepare the tissue for cryosectioning using a cryomold and OCT compound.

substeps.instruction: Coat a labeled cryomold with a thin layer of OCT compound and set aside.
Pour the contents of the 15 mL conical tube (pancreas in 30% sucrose) into a 100 mm tissue culture dish.
Pick up the pancreas with fine forceps and blot excess sucrose using Kimwipes.
Place the pancreas into the cryomold, using forceps to gently push the tissue to the bottom.
Place the cryomold on dry ice, fill the remaining volume with OCT to cover the pancreas, and freeze until the OCT is opaque.

steps.title: Store and Section Tissue
steps.instruction: Store the frozen blocks and perform cryosectioning.

substeps.instruction: Wrap the frozen cryomold in a pre-labeled square of aluminum foil, place in a sealed plastic bag, and store at -80 °C.
Cut cryosections at 5-10 μm thickness and mount to Plus Gold charged slides.
For mass quantification, collect cryosections throughout the entire pancreas to obtain at least 5 sections 200 μm apart.
